items.raw_excerpt: Amateur bird-watchers are being called on to help with the great bittern bird count.
items.summary_en: Conservationists want amateur bird-watchers to join a nationwide bittern count. The great bittern is one of New Zealand's most endangered birds. The count helps track how many are left across the country.
items.summary_ko: 보호 활동가들이 전국적인 큰고라니 개체 수 조사에 일반 조류 관찰자들의 참여를 요청하고 있습니다. 큰고라니는 뉴질랜드에서 가장 멸종 위기에 처한 조류 중 하나입니다. 이번 조사는 전국에 남은 개체 수를 파악하는 데 도움이 됩니다.
items.title_en: Bird-watchers asked to help count rare bitterns in New Zealand

items.title_original: Conservationists call on bird-watchers to help save one of NZ's most endangered birds

items.raw_excerpt: Approximately 160 people work at the NGO.
items.summary_en: A Finnish mental health organization is cutting jobs after the government reduced its funding. Mieli Mental Health Finland supports people with mental health challenges across the country. Approximately 160 people work at the organization.

items.raw_excerpt: What's a support sausage and when do you need one? The Local explains in our Swedish Word of the Day series.

items.raw_excerpt: We asked our readers what it's like to live as an LGBTQI+ person in Spain and how it compares to the US, UK, Australia and other countries. Overwhelmingly, the results were positive, although of course there were differing opinions.
items.summary_en: LGBTQI+ people in Spain share their daily lives. They say being queer is widely accepted. Their experiences are often positive compared to other countries.

items.raw_excerpt: Apartment prices vary sharply between Austria’s nine state capitals, with more than €3,500 per square metre separating the cheapest and most expensive in a new market comparison.
items.summary_en: Apartment prices differ a lot between Austria's nine state capitals. The gap between the cheapest and most expensive cities is over €3,500 per square metre. A new comparison shows where buyers can find the best deals.

items.summary_en: Athens public transport authority OASA will launch new bus routes connecting towns in East and West Attica starting September 18. The new lines aim to improve daily commutes for local residents across the wider Athens region.

items.raw_excerpt: Isilda Mendes tem 61 anos e nasceu e cresceu em Ferraria de São João, no concelho de Penela. PUBLICIDADE A…
items.summary_en: Isilda Mendes is 61 years old and was born and grew up in Ferraria de Sao Joao, in the Penela area. She has made cheese for more than 40 years and has never taken a holiday. Her life is tied to this small village from the very beginning.
items.summary_ko: 이실다 멘데스는 61세로, 페넬라 지역의 페라리아 데 상 조앙 마을에서 태어나 줄곧 그곳에서 살았다. 그는 40년 넘게 치즈를 만들어 왔고 한 번도 휴가를 보낸 적이 없다. 그의 삶은 처음부터 이 작은 마을에 깊게 얽혀 있다.
items.title_en: Isilda Mendes has lived in this village in Penela her whole life. She has made cheese for over 40 years and has never had a holiday
items.title_ko: 평생 페넬라의 한 마을에 산 이실다 멘데스, 40년 넘게 치즈를 만들고 한 번도 휴가를 못 냈다
items.title_original: Isilda Mendes vive desde sempre nesta aldeia de Penela. Faz queijo há mais de 40 anos e nunca teve férias - Notícias de Coimbra

items.raw_excerpt: Enrichment providers say families are increasingly looking to art to develop creativity, confidence and communication skills.
items.summary_en: Parents in Singapore are turning to art enrichment classes for their children. They believe these classes help develop creativity, confidence, and communication skills. Some families also see art as an advantage for school admissions.

items.raw_excerpt: Water dripping from air conditioning ducts and undersized screws used in ceiling panels caused the ceiling of the cafeteria at the parliament complex in Bangkok to collapse on Sunday, an inspection has found.
items.summary_en: A ceiling inside Thailand's parliament cafeteria in Bangkok collapsed on Sunday. Inspectors found that water leaking from air conditioning ducts and screws that were too small weakened the ceiling panels. No injuries were reported in the incident.
items.summary_ko: 방콕 국회의사당 구내식당의 천장이 지난 일요일 무너졌다. 조사 결과 에어컨 덕트에서 새는 물과 크기가 부족한 나사가 천장 패널을 약하게 만든 것으로 확인됐다. 이번 사고로 인한 부상자는 보고되지 않았다.
items.title_en: Air conditioning leaks and tiny screws caused parliament cafeteria ceiling to fall in Bangkok
items.title_ko: 방콕 국회의사당 구내식당 천장 붕괴 원인은 에어컨 누수와 작은 나사
items.title_original: AC condensation, undersized screws caused parliament ceiling collapse

items.raw_excerpt: New research released ahead of the Moving to Portugal Show in Dublin on 22 September shows Irish purchasers are among the leading international buyers.
items.summary_en: New research shows Irish buyers are among the top international purchasers of prime property in Portugal's Algarve region. The findings were released ahead of the Moving to Portugal Show in Dublin on 22 September. Ireland's real estate buyers continue to show strong demand for homes in southern Portugal.
items.summary_ko: 새 연구에 따르면 아일랜드 구매자들이 포르투갈 알가르브 지역 고급 부동산의 주요 해외 구매자 그룹에 속한다. 관련 조사 결과는 9월 22일 더블린에서 열리는 포르투갈 이주 쇼를 앞두고 공개됐다. 아일랜드 구매자들은 남포르투갈 주택에 대한 수요를 꾸준히 이어가고 있다.

items.raw_excerpt: Kerala High Court dismisses Augustine brothers' plea, directing trial court to proceed with the Muttil tree-felling case.
items.summary_en: The Kerala High Court dismissed the Augustine brothers' plea to stop court proceedings. The case involves the cutting down of trees in Muttil. The trial court in Chottanikkara will now continue with the case.
items.summary_ko: 케랄라 고등법원은 뮤틸 지역 나무 베기 사건과 관련한 어거스틴 형제들의 재정지급 청구를 기각했습니다. 법원은 초타니카라 재판소에 사건 진행을 지시했습니다. 이 사건은 뮤틸 지역의 나무 베기와 관련된 것입니다.
items.title_en: Kerala court rejects brothers' plea in Muttil tree-felling case
items.title_ko: 케랄라 법원, 뮤틸 나무 베기 사건에서 형제들의 청구 기각

items.raw_excerpt: The 16-year-old heads into the upcoming competition in Japan fresh from clinching silver at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow in July – Singapore's first gymnastics medal at the Games since 2014.
items.summary_en: 16-year-old Singapore gymnast Amanda Yap will compete at the Asian Games in Japan. She recently won silver at the Commonwealth Games, marking Singapore's first gymnastics medal there since 2014.
items.summary_ko: 16세 싱가포르 체조 선수 아만다 야프가 일본 아시안게임에 첫 출전합니다. 그녀는 최근 코먼웰스게임에서 은메달을 따며 2014년 이후 싱가포르 체조 최초의 메달을 기록했습니다.
items.title_en: Singapore gymnast Amanda Yap targets balance beam final on Asian Games debut
items.title_ko: 싱가포르 체조 아만다 야프, 아시안게임 첫 무대서 평균대 결승 도전
items.title_original: Singapore gymnast Amanda Yap targets balance beam final on Asian Games debut

items.raw_excerpt: The research which led the government to put €507,000 into a primary school backed by far-right party Forum voor Democratie was flawed and did not include key information, experts have told the Volkskrant. The Renaissance school opened its doors in Almere this school year with just four pupils, well below the number required for official funding. But officials agreed to back the school because research apparently showed there would be a demand for new schools in the area over the...
items.summary_en: A primary school backed by far-right party Forum voor Democratie in Almere opened with just four students. Government officials approved €507,000 in funding based on research that experts now call misleading. The study failed to include key information about real demand for new schools in the area.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 앨미레에 위치한 극우 정당 포럼 보르 데모크라치의 지원을 받는 초등학교가 올해 학기 개교 당시 학생이 단 4명에 불과했습니다. 정부 당국은 해당 지역 신규 학교 수요를 보여주는 연구를 근거로 50만 7천 유로의 지원금을 승인했지만, 전문가들은 해당 연구가 핵심 정보를 누락한 오해의 소지가 있는 연구였다고 지적했습니다.
items.title_en: Experts say flawed research was used to fund tiny far-right party school
items.title_ko: 전문가들, 극우 정당 지원 학교 관련 정부 연구가 편향적이었다고 비판
items.title_original: Far-right party school research was misleading, experts say

items.raw_excerpt: El presentador de 'El Hormiguero' se sincera y cuenta todas las travesuras que protagonizó cuando era pequeño
items.summary_en: Spanish TV presenter Pablo Motos opened up about his childhood in a small town near Valencia. He said he spent his days trying to do something bad, and even set his parents' house on fire twice.
items.summary_ko: 스페인 TV 진행자 파블로 모토스가 발렌시아 근처 작은 마을에서 보낸 어린 시절 이야기를 털어놨다. 그는 온종일 말썽을 부리려고 몸부림쳤으며, 부모님 집에 두 번이나 불을 낸 적이 있다고 고백했다.
items.title_en: TV host Pablo Motos recalls his naughty childhood in a Valencia village

items.title_original: Pablo Motos, sobre su infancia en un pueblo de Valencia: «Me pasaba la vida intentando hacer algo malo. Incendié dos veces la casa de mis padres» - abc.es

items.raw_excerpt: Many people have never questioned the safety of milk coming from Swiss cows, which spend their summers grazing on pristine Alpine pastures. But a new university study refutes this wholesome image.
items.summary_en: Many people never question the safety of milk from Swiss cows, which graze on Alpine pastures in summer. But a new university study questions this clean image. Researchers may have found rubber in the milk.
items.summary_ko: 사람들은 여름에 알프스 목초지에서 풀을 뜯는 스위스 소의 우유가 안전하다고 의심하지 않는 경우가 많습니다. 그런데 한 대학의 새로운 연구가 이 청정 이미지에 의문을 제기했습니다. 연구진은 우유에서 고무 물질을 발견했을 가능성이 있습니다.
items.title_en: Is Swiss milk safe to drink or full of rubber?
items.title_ko: 스위스 우유, 마셔도 안전할까? 아니면 고무가 들어있을까?
items.title_original: Is Swiss milk safe to drink... or full of rubber?

items.raw_excerpt: Portugal is known for its golden beaches, historic villages, rolling countryside, cork oak forests, wetlands, and Atlantic coastline. However, it doesn't take much effort to discover the country's natural beauty if you don't go too far. Sometimes, you don't need to look far to find something in nature that displays art.
items.summary_en: Portugal has golden beaches, old villages, rolling hills, cork oak forests, wetlands, and an Atlantic coast. You do not need to travel far to see nature's beauty. Sometimes you can find art in nature right outside your home.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈은 황금빛 해변, 오래된 마을, 구릉 지대, 코르크 참나무 숲, 습지, 대서양 해안으로 유명합니다. 하지만 멀리 가지 않아도 자연의 아름다움을 쉽게 발견할 수 있습니다. 때로는 집 밖에서도 자연이 만든 예술 같은 풍경을 볼 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: A New Way to Enjoy Portugal's Nature from Your Terrace or Garden
items.title_ko: 포르투갈 자연을 테라스나 정원에서 즐기는 새 방법
items.title_original: A New Way to Enjoy Portugal's Nature from Your Terrace or Garden
